summary: Self-Claim Referral feature E2E tested on PRODUCTION (https://www.parasreward.com). Backend endpoints (/api/referral/lookup/{code} and /api/referral/apply/{uid}) are DEPLOYED and FULLY WORKING with correct edge-case handling. Frontend UI flow (CTA -> modal -> live lookup -> submit -> persistence) is WORKING. One minor UX bug: CTA does not auto-hide immediately after a successful claim because refreshUserData() is invoked without the required uid argument.
deployment_status: LATEST CODE IS DEPLOYED ON PRODUCTION (lookup endpoint exists, apply endpoint exists, all guards working). NOT a deployment issue.

minor.issue: Login response does NOT include referred_by_name, referred_via, referred_at fields (only referred_by). These are written to DB correctly on /referral/apply but never returned to frontend. Frontend cannot show 'You were referred by X' on profile without an extra round-trip.

ui_bugs.issue: `refreshUserData()` called with no argument. App.js defines `refreshUserData = async (uid) => fetch(/api/user/${uid})`. With uid=undefined, the fetch hits /api/user/undefined which returns 401 'Authentication required'. Net effect: user state in App.js is NOT updated after a successful self-claim, so `canClaimReferrer = !user.referred_by` remains true and the purple 'Did someone refer you?' CTA stays visible until the next full page reload. Backend data IS persisted correctly (verified via re-login + one-shot guard firing on retry).

production_backend_verification.POST /api/referral/apply/{admin_uid} win: 400 'Referral claim window closed. ... account is 134 days old'
production_backend_verification.POST /api/referral/apply/{fresh_uid} re-: 400 'You already have a referrer attached. This action is one-shot.'

frontend_ui_verification.Toast displays success message: Did not capture (sonner auto-dismissed before DOM query). Not blocking.

action_items: FIX (1-line): /app/frontend/src/pages/ReferralsEnhanced.js line ~155 — change `refreshUserData()` to `refreshUserData(user.uid)` so the user prop refreshes and the CTA auto-hides after a successful claim. (Backend already persists correctly; this is purely UI staleness.)

OPTIONAL: include referred_by_name / referred_via / referred_at in /api/auth/login and /api/user/{uid} response payloads so frontend can later display 'Referred by X' attribution badge without an extra call.
critical_code_review_comments: Referral apply window check (referral.py L116-117) silently swallows ValueError on malformed timestamps and falls through to allow the claim. Comment says 'let the user claim anyway' — acceptable but worth a logging.warning so abuse via timestamp tampering is visible in logs.

Cycle-check depth in referral.py L129 hardcoded to 20. If genuine network depth ever exceeds 20 levels the loop exits silently without rejecting — at that point it would let a true circular chain slip through. Consider bumping to a configurable constant or asserting on the network depth limit.
Login response (auth.py) excludes referred_by_name/referred_via/referred_at. These fields ARE written by /referral/apply but not echoed back, forcing extra round-trips on the client.

rca_of_the_issue: USER REPORT 'Self-Claim Referral NOT working on production' is INCORRECT in absolute terms. Backend works perfectly. The user-observable symptom is likely: after successfully claiming a referrer, the purple CTA card stays visible until manual page reload, giving the impression that nothing happened. Root cause is in /app/frontend/src/pages/ReferralsEnhanced.js handleSubmitClaim — `refreshUserData()` is invoked without the uid argument App.js expects, so the in-memory user object is never refreshed (the fetch goes to /api/user/undefined and returns 401). Backend has already persisted referred_by; the user just doesn't see the UI flip. Fix: pass `user.uid`. Reproduction: 1) Register a fresh user without referral_code, 2) Login, 3) Go to /referrals, 4) Click CTA, type valid code, submit, 5) Modal closes but CTA still visible. Reload page -> CTA gone. Mitigation: 1-line fix in ReferralsEnhanced.js.
